verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party way to version, review, or roll back agent definitions or automations. Agents are defined in Python code, so any versioning would come from the user's own source control, which is a user-side workaround. The adjacent features cited (durable execution that preserves run progress, deferred-tool approval, and Logfire evals that compare a candidate against a baseline) are related but different capabilities, so none of them count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
